verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents dynamic, metric-based request routing across model providers and load balancing across multiple LLM models, plus per-request cost calculation, which together support policy-driven mid-task model switching by cost/availability. However, there's no explicit documentation of capability-based routing rules, dynamic model selection mid-conversation, or agent-driven switching logic — the evidence covers load balancing/failover-style routing more than fine-grained policy-based mid-task switching. Missing for 10: explicit capability-based routing policy config, documented mid-task/dynamic model switching by an agent, and independent/hands-on confirmation of routing behavior under real workloads.
